note: Cases mirror closed_circuit.rs validate_failure_arms, validate_modal_shell_overlay_contract and validate_dead_bodiless_actions, run only on client-bound traits (a route page's traits plus the @trait embed closure from config defaults, guards, effects and ticks), each with paired controls. Each case carries LINT_INDEX roots for the traits that embed and the pattern registry props the node-typed check reads. Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion the Rust validator reports for the same program.

findings.message: transition idle--[GO]-->idle declares `emit: { failure: FAIL }` but state 'idle' has no arm handling 'FAIL' — the failure is never caught
findings.suggestion: Add a transition `from: 'idle', event: 'FAIL'` that handles the failure (e.g. render an error toast).

findings.message: state 'idle' handles failure event 'FAIL' but its arm neither renders nor emits a declared event — the failure reaches no one
findings.suggestion: Emit a failure event the trait declares in `emits` from the 'FAIL' arm (its embedder presents it), or render it.

findings.message: state 'b' mounts an overlay-slot pattern but has no `CLOSE`/`CANCEL` arm — the shell's own X/Escape/overlay-click control fires into nothing
findings.suggestion: Add a `CLOSE` (or `CANCEL`) arm in state 'b' that clears the overlay slot.

findings.message: transition idle--[OPEN]-->b renders a self-overlaying pattern (`slideOver: true`, or a nested `modal`/`confirm-dialog`) inside an overlay slot payload — the generic portal shell wraps it too, stacking two overlay chromes
findings.suggestion: Render the inner content pattern into the slot instead (the shell already provides the chrome and the X), or make the self-overlaying pattern the slot payload's ROOT node, which the shell renders bare.

findings.message: 'BACK' moves b -> idle but carries no effects — the machine leaves b while the screen keeps its paint, so every affordance routed here is dead and the surface now disagrees with the state it is in
findings.suggestion: give the arm the body 'idle' should show — copy idle's INIT render (and its fetch, if any) into the arm. An (emit INIT) is not a substitute: the bus never delivers lifecycle events
